list.name: group
list.label: Global Collection
list.query: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name
list.definition: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name

list.name: devices
list.label: Devices
list.query: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1

list.name: deviceType
list.label: Device Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_type FROM reporting.devicemodel WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL AND destroy_time IS NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT device_type FROM reporting.devicemodel WHERE device_type IS NOT NULL AND destroy_time IS NULL ORDER BY 1

options.content: **Business-Hours Availability** — downtime is counted only within the business window **$bizStart:00–$bizEnd:00**, Count Weekends = **$countWeekends** (0=No, 1=Yes). Availability % = 1 − (business-hours downtime ÷ business hours in period). Set Start=0, End=24, Weekends=1 to reproduce 24×7.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100*(1 - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizStart HOUR), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizEnd HOUR)))),0) FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key JOIN reporting.time_dimension td ON td.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE(GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom())) AND DATE(LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())) AND ($countWeekends=1 OR td.weekend_flag='N') WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom())) / ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.model_key) FROM reporting.devicemodel dm WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR dm.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR dm.model_key IN ($devices))) * (SELECT SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizStart HOUR), LEAST($__timeTo(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizEnd HOUR)))) FROM reporting.time_dimension td WHERE td.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo()) AND ($countWeekends=1 OR td.weekend_flag='N')))),3) AS bh_fleet_avail

SELECT ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizStart HOUR), LEAST($__timeTo(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizEnd HOUR))))/3600,1) AS biz_hours FROM reporting.time_dimension td WHERE td.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo()) AND ($countWeekends=1 OR td.weekend_flag='N')

SELECT ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizStart HOUR), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizEnd HOUR))))/3600,1) AS bh_downtime_hrs FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key JOIN reporting.time_dimension td ON td.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE(GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom())) AND DATE(LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())) AND ($countWeekends=1 OR td.weekend_flag='N') WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom())

SELECT X.Name AS `Name`, X.IP AS `IP`, X.Type AS `Device Type`, CONCAT(FLOOR(X.bh/86400),' Days ',LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(X.bh,86400)/3600),2,'0'),':',LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(X.bh,3600)/60),2,'0'),':',LPAD(MOD(X.bh,60),2,'0')) AS `Total Downtime (BH)`, X.outages AS `Number of Outages`, ROUND(100*(1 - X.bh/B.biz_seconds),4) AS `Availability %` FROM (SELECT e.entity_name AS Name, dm.IP AS IP, dm.device_type AS Type, COUNT(DISTINCT mo.model_outage_ID) AS outages, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizStart HOUR), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizEnd HOUR)))) AS bh FROM reporting.modeloutage mo JOIN reporting.entity e ON e.current_model_key=mo.model_key JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=mo.model_key JOIN reporting.time_dimension td ON td.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE(GREATEST(mo.start_time,$__timeFrom())) AND DATE(LEAST(COALESCE(mo.end_time,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())) AND ($countWeekends=1 OR td.weekend_flag='N') WHERE mo.outage_type IN ($outageType) AND dm.device_type IN (${deviceType:singlequote}) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR mo.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR mo.model_key IN ($devices)) AND mo.start_time<$__timeTo() AND (mo.end_time IS NULL OR mo.end_time>=$__timeFrom()) GROUP BY e.entity_name, dm.IP, dm.device_type) X CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizStart HOUR), LEAST($__timeTo(), td.calendar_date + INTERVAL $bizEnd HOUR)))) AS biz_seconds FROM reporting.time_dimension td WHERE td.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo()) AND ($countWeekends=1 OR td.weekend_flag='N')) B ORDER BY X.bh DESC LIMIT $topN
